title: Owner-gate triage
_doc: Used by lib/governance.decide() for a category the owner set to 'triage'. v2 = v1's rules with fact provenance: every fact that can loosen the answer is a safety input that counts only when a record vouches for it (sources below), never on the acting seat's word; governance builds those facts itself. An actor-supplied safety fact is treated as absent, so the rule escalates. proceed-notify = goes ahead and the owner is told; escalate = waits for the owner. Spend passes only under the owner-set maxSpendUsd (ships at 0). Fixed owner gates never reach this model. Outcomes: any bad outcome on a live proceed-notify in 30 days demotes the version to shadow. docs/DECISION-MODELS.md.

category.doc: the self-governance category (set by the tool that asks, not a claim)

amountUsd.doc: money this act commits, in USD: the amount the tool is about to commit (governance: the request), or the ledger

recurring.doc: the cost or act repeats on its own; false only from the owner's oneOffCategories table

vendorKnown.doc: the vendor is one the company already pays or has on its allowlist / party registry

seatHistoryOk.doc: the deciding seat has a competence record with no serious or waiting flaw

reversible.doc: the act can be undone fully: only from the owner's reversibleCategories table

externalRecipientKnown.doc: the recipient has a live external-gate clearance, is on the allowlist, or is a registered party

summary.doc: the act in one line (not used by rules; kept out of the log)

maxSpendUsd.doc: spend strictly below this may proceed-notify; 0 = no spend passes. Set by the owner: decide.js set-param gate-triage maxSpendUsd <n> --by <owner>

reversibleCategories.doc: comma-separated categories the owner declares reversible (the only source of reversible:true besides the owner); empty = none. decide.js set-param gate-triage reversibleCategories tools,schedules --by <owner>

oneOffCategories.doc: comma-separated categories the owner declares one-off (recurring:false); empty = none

rules.why: a fixed owner gate is always the owner's
people, budget and new lines of business stay with the owner
recurring, or not known to be a one-off
the amount is at or above the owner's triage threshold
small one-off reversible spend to a known vendor, under the owner's threshold
spend without a known vendor or a stated amount
reversible outbound act to a known recipient by a seat in good standing
reversible one-off change by a seat in good standing

default.why: nothing shows this is safe to do alone
